title: CPCSC Level 1 account lifecycle and use need assessed records
remediation: The sponsor account management owner confirms the CPCSC Level 1 contract boundary and approves which accounts, users, roles and privileges apply there. Collect redacted authorization, creation or change, usage monitoring and removal samples. Include approved inactivity and expiration rules, a documented disablement and notification, and proof the assigned logout rule applies. The sponsor separately confirms applicability to the CPCSC Level 1 contract and certification boundary. An ITSP.10.171 reference or evidence mapped for a different assessed system establishes no disposition for this contract.

milestones.title: For CPCSC Level 1, collect the approved assessed account inventory, a redacted account lifecycle sample, disablement notification and effective logout evidence
